dir  0755 root     /var/lib/princo
dir  0750 princo-engine /var/lib/princo/files
file 0600 root     /var/lib/princo/files/monitor.json
file 0640 princo-engine /var/lib/princo/files/sing-box.json
file 0644 root     /var/lib/princo/rules/geoip-ru.srs
file 0644 root     /var/lib/princo/rules/geosite-category-ru.srs
file 0644 root     /etc/systemd/system/princo.service
file 0644 root     /etc/systemd/system/princo-monitor.service
file 0644 root     /etc/systemd/system/princo-monitor.timer
unit princo.service reload=false check=["/usr/local/lib/princo/sing-box-1.14.3/sing-box" "check" "-c" "/var/lib/princo/files/sing-box.json"]
  /etc/systemd/system/princo.service
  /var/lib/princo/files/sing-box.json
  /var/lib/princo/rules/geoip-ru.srs
  /var/lib/princo/rules/geosite-category-ru.srs
unit princo-monitor.timer reload=false check=[]
  /etc/systemd/system/princo-monitor.service
  /etc/systemd/system/princo-monitor.timer
